name: Misuzu no Kuni
source:
Made as a promotion for [url=/v25768]Kirin no Kuni[/url]. Gold prize in the 10th Freem! Game Contest.

One day, Misuzu ceased to be human. According to legal jurisdiction, she had become a Tengu. 

She had two options in front of her: Live the rest of her life under government surveillance and have all her basics freedoms stripped away from her, or venture onwards to the realm of the Tengu.  

This is a story of hardships, setbacks, farewells and chances encounters. This is Misuzu's story.

[Translated from the description from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6365]Freem[/url]]
translation:
为宣传[url=/v25768]《麒麟之国》[/url]而制作。第10届Freem!游戏大赛金奖作品。

某天，Misuzu不再是人类。按照法律认定，她已经成了天狗。

摆在她面前的只有两个选择，余生在政府监视下度过，被剥夺一切基本自由，或是前往天狗的世界。

这是一个关于艰辛、挫折、离别与邂逅的故事。这是Misuzu的故事。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6365]Freem[/url]的作品介绍]
